thread:
Alex M.: Quick sync — integration sprint gate check. I just merged quant recs into branch `opt-deliver/quant-recs` (PR #4567). TL;DR: int8 profile + model reordering gives ~2.1x throughput, but there’s a cache-key change that could trigger regressions for long-context chat. Need owners for canary + perf regression watch.

Jia L.: Awesome. Can you paste the recommended batching config?

Alex M.: Sure — recommended defaults (starting point):
```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_items: 16
  batch_window_ms: 12
  prefix_cache: enabled
```
Note: we lowered batch_window to keep tail latency under 120ms for small queries.

Samir: Quick question — the cache-key change, does it break deterministic embedding caching? I remember a flag in the client that would need to flip.

Alex M.: Yes — we include `session_id` in the prefix key now to avoid cross-user KV leaks for some reuse patterns. That will break old cached entries. We have a migration plan in the PR description to invalidate selectively.

Lorna: Who's owning the rollout? I can do canary on Dedicated in eu-west1 if Morgan approves infra changes.

Morgan (SRE): I saw the kernel patch request from eng-runtime — we need to coordinate a small driver bump on the dedicated pool. I can approve if eng-runtime confirms the fallback path is tested. Also will need a brief maintenance window (15m) to rotate GPUs for the driver.

Alex M.: Thanks — proposed owners: Lorna for Dedicated canary (eu-west1), Jia for Hosted API canary (us-west2), Samir to own the regression test set and alerts. Morgan to schedule driver bump and give greenlight. I'm happy to coordinate roll cadence.

Jia L.: I can run the hosted canary. Need a short smoke test checklist:
- 10k small prompts -> latency P95 under 180ms
- 1k long-context (8k tokens) -> output sanity checks (subset auto-eval)
- embedding unit test for cache invalidation

Samir: I'll add regression checks to the nightly eval — adding two prompt sets (conversational and codegen) and a metric for token-per-second + distrib diffs. If we see quality drift > 1.5% on BLEU/ROUGE-like metric we rollback.

Lorna: SGTG on dedicated canary after Morgan schedules the driver rotation. I can do staged ramp: 1%, 5%, 20% over 6 hours with hourly checkpoints.

Morgan (SRE): Scheduler: I can do driver rotation Monday 09:00 UTC (should be low traffic). Rolling plan: drain, rotate, smoke, then ramp. Will post exact maintenance stub to #incidents once set.

Alex M.: Action items: 1) Jia -> run hosted canary and post results (eta Tue EOD) 2) Lorna -> run Dedicated canary after Morgan fix (eta Wed) 3) Samir -> add regression sets + alerts (ETA Mon morning) 4) Morgan -> schedule rotation and post maintenance stub (ETA Fri). I'll keep the PR updated with canary links.

deploy-bot: CI: PR #4567 passed unit tests and integration smoke. Staging deploy queued (job 8921).

Jia L.: noted. I'll kick off the hosted canary once staging job 8921 completes. @Samir can you ensure the auto-eval hooks are subscribed to the canary trace?

Samir: On it — adding webhook to canary tracepoint now. Also will add an auto-notify to #eng-ml for any regression alert.

Lorna: small compatibility note — a few internal infra clients still set `cache_version` explicitly. We should add a deprecation note and a client-side helper to rehydrate old caches. I'll draft a short PR after the canary.

Alex M.: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here. Otherwise I'll mark this thread as the integration hub for the roll. :thumbsup:

Jia L.: :thumbsup:

Morgan (SRE): I'll update with exact maintenance times by EOD.

Samir: ETA for regression bundle is Monday 10:00 UTC.

Lorna: Starting canary plan doc now — will link once ready.
